text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
1st place. This is... me giving it my all 
and taking 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That really was a long journey...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Weak as I was, I was pushed from behind, 
pulled along, chasing after them...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Right now, at long last... I'm standing 
on my own two feet!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can fight with pride. On that 
stage... with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I won't run away anymore. And I won't 
betray everyone's expectations."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Without a doubt... I will win.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"—At the 'Arima Kinen', I'm gonna be the 
sparkliest main character!"
